records.observation: Official NRL game-day late mail confirms Twidle shifts from fullback to the interchange.

records.observation: Official NRL post-match reporting confirms Yeo came from the interchange and successfully returned in Penrith's 38-10 Round 27 win after three games out.
records.macro_effect: Removes the prior uncertainty about whether Yeo could complete a Round 27 return. Finals Week One selection and workload remain unconfirmed until the official team list and later checkpoint evidence.

records.observation: Official NRL post-match reporting confirms Kenny started at hooker and successfully returned in Penrith's 38-10 Round 27 win.
